svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
Stator-as-mount, Z measured aft from the pod nose
rating held for NAC-64 power gate
Bench-test rotation: port CW from the intake, starboard CCW; swap two phases to reverse.
Stage 2 (aft): pod Z 4.10-6.96 in (104.2-176.9 mm); hold the 0.04 in (1.0 mm) interstage gap.
Bolt each motor to its stator (4 x M3 on O16 mm, VERIFY); fit stage 2 first.
Route phase leads along the vanes to the ESC bays (from Z 3.40 in / 86.35 mm aft).
EDFs on bench power can cut fingers. Keep hands, tools, and clothing clear of the duct during the rotation test.
Motor and rotor stations are VERIFY until NAC-64-FIT-02 measures a real QF2822.
